people.line: The people you send tasks and what {name} made to, who also use {name}, and get their answers back from. Only they can open what you send them.
people.qr: The invitation as a QR code, for their phone’s camera
people.point: They point their phone’s camera at the code, or open the link. It works while this stays open.
people.week: Send it the way you send them anything else. It works for a week.
people.waiting: Waiting for them to open it…
people.typeCode: The six digits {name} shows you or sends back

people.wrong.one: Those digits don’t match. {count} try left.
people.wrong.other: Those digits don’t match. {count} tries left.

people.added: {name} is in your people. Once they answer, you can send each other tasks.
people.accepted: Someone accepted your invitation for {name}. Type the six digits they sent you back.
people.again: To meet again: their key changed in a way that couldn’t be checked
people.remove: Remove {name}? What they sent you stays yours.
people.invited: Someone invites you to send each other tasks with {name}.
people.seen: They’ll see the name this profile goes by.
people.accepting: Waiting for the person who invited you…
people.showCode: Show these digits to the person beside you, or send them back the way the invitation came
people.metThem: {name} is in your people now. You can send each other tasks.
people.size: {size}, of the {limit} that can go at once
people.opens: They have a week to open it.
people.why.waiting: They haven’t answered yet. Once they do, you can send them things.
people.why.large: This is too large to send. Without what {name} read, or one part of it, it may fit.
people.why.unreached: This didn’t reach them. Check the connection and try again.
people.why.link: This isn’t an invitation link. Ask for it again.
people.why.used: This invitation was already used. Ask for a new one.
people.why.gone: This invitation was stopped or ran out. Ask for a new one.
people.why.self: This is your own invitation. Send it to the other person.
people.why.known: This person is already in your people.
people.why.tries: Three wrong tries: it stopped, to be safe. Start again.
people.why.relay: This can’t be reached right now. Check the connection and try again.
people.why.child: A child’s profile doesn’t add people.
